title: Line Integral Around a Triangle via Green's Theorem
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate oint_C (xy dx + x^2 dy) around the triangle with vertices (0, 0), (1, 0), and (1, 1) counterclockwise.

steps.title: Apply Green's Theorem to Convert to Double Integral
steps.mathExpression: M = xy, \; N = x^2 \implies \frac{\partial N}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = 2x - x = x
steps.explanation: Compute the difference of partial derivatives.

steps.title: Evaluate Double Integral over Triangle
steps.mathExpression: \iint_T x \, dA = \int_0^1 \int_0^x x \, dy \, dx = \int_0^1 x^2 \, dx = \left[ \frac{x^3}{3} \right]_0^1 = \frac{1}{3}
steps.explanation: Integrate x over the triangle 0 <= y <= x, 0 <= x <= 1.
